purpose: Make the remaining MF-288 and H-22 censuses reproducible from locked source bytes instead of relying on visual judgment or prior narrative measurements.

stages.name: Center and radius calibration
stages.method: estimate center/radius independently per source; retain uncertainty

stages.name: Polar normalization
stages.method: map samples to normalized (rho,theta) without treating normalized raster pixels as fields

stages.name: 72-boundary census
stages.method: for each predicted 5-degree boundary search a bounded local angular neighborhood and measure line evidence across radial spans

stages.name: Radial census
stages.method: aggregate circular-edge evidence over theta; distinguish persistent circular boundaries from local text/symbol edges

stages.name: Cross-source radial matching
stages.method: match normalized radial boundaries with explicit tolerance and source-specific classification

stages.name: MF-288 continuity census
stages.method: evaluate each conditional R01..R04 × S00..S71 address using radial and left/right angular boundary support

stages.name: Central rose segmentation
stages.method: segment compositional cells independently of outer 72-fold rays; count observed layers/cells before testing 3/7/12

stages.name: Topology freeze candidate
stages.method: build graph only from SUPPORTED fields/cells; preserve unresolved gaps

antiTargetFitting: Do not alter thresholds to obtain 72, 441, 22 or any desired cardinality.
Report sensitivity across a declared threshold range.
Keep outer and central topology independent until evidenced bridge relations exist.
Do not infer symbolic meaning from geometry alone.
Do not assign AK IDs during measurement stages.
completionGate: Only a run with verified source hashes, declared parameters, complete per-field evidence and reproducible outputs can open G4 Atomic-Kode assignment.
